messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx and truncated streaming responses on /v1/paging/stream — correlated with canary rollout of SDK v0.16 (canary id: canary-78). Auto-pages show mid-stream CLOSE frames. Severity: potential customer impact. Please ack and gather.
laura-ops: Ack. Seeing 5xx rate jump from ~0.2% to ~4.8% across canary region us-west-2. Paging streams are closing at ~20-40 tokens in for some sessions.
raj-oncall: Oncall here, looking at logs. Any quick mitigation we can flip? Is there a feature flag for the rollout?
dana-eng: Yes there's a canary traffic split flag. I'm pulling up control plane now.
olga-sdks: Quick context — v0.16 changed the streaming handshake to include a paging-token header and expects chunked continuation. Older gateways drop unknown header and force connection close in our current proxy behavior.
laura-ops: That would explain truncated streams. Which customers routed to canary? mike-cs, do we have customer impact reports?
mike-cs: CustomerBetaA and PartnerEmbedder saw elevated errors; PartnerEmbedder reported ~70% failure on long-paged responses for the last 30m. I messaged both — telling them we are investigating and will update.
raj-oncall: OK, Dana, can you kill the canary via flag? If we can stop traffic to canary that should stop new affected sessions.
dana-eng: Doing now. Command:
```
# disable canary traffic
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/flags/canary-78 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

laura-ops: I see the flag flip (event id 9a3f). New traffic to canary has dropped to 0. Rolling error rate down... hold for 60s.
raj-oncall: Metrics: 5xx rate falling back to baseline in us-west-2. Latency normalizing. :thumbsup:
olga-sdks: FYI the proxy change that rejects unknown headers was deployed two days ago as part of a separate patch. That plus the handshake change in v0.16 produced an incompat. We'll need a short-term proxy tolerance or revert.
laura-ops: Any ongoing sessions that were already started still truncated? We're seeing some residual CLOSE events but no new ones after flag off.
mike-cs: PartnerEmbedder says errors stopped after 2:14pm. They want an incident summary and ETA for a proper fix.
raj-oncall: I'll do a quick rollback of the proxy change in the canary fleet if we see residuals. Dana, can you coordinate? Also tagging eng-sre.
dana-eng: Rolling back proxy behaviour on canary nodes now. Command:
```
kubectl set image deploy/proxy-deploy proxy=proxy:canary-revert-20260315 --namespace=canary
```

laura-ops: Revert deployed to canary pods. Observability shows immediate drop in CLOSE frames for older client handshakes.
raj-oncall: Confirming: error rate is back to normal cluster-wide. Customer reports coming in say service restored. Marking immediate mitigation successful. :tada:
mike-cs: Notifying customers that we disabled the canary and reverted proxy change; they requested root cause and timeline. I'll prepare a short customer note.
olga-sdks: Next steps from SDK side: patch v0.16 to include backward-compatible handshake fallback and add a version negotiation header to avoid this in the future.
dana-eng: Postmortem owner: dana-eng. Initial severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting but mitigated within ~15-20m). Action items:
- revert proxy change from canary to stable (done)
- disable canary rollout for v0.16 (done)
- SDK team to produce v0.16.1 with handshake fallback (olga)
- infra to add tolerant header parsing for a week while patch lands (laura/eng-sre)
- CS to send customer update and affected list (mike)
- add integration test: old-client vs new-proxy handshake matrix (eng-mdx)

raj-oncall: I'm handing off monitoring to laura for the next 2 hours while I go take post-incident actions. laura, msg me if anything regresses.
laura-ops: Ack, I'll watch dashboards and logs. Setting a 60m watch window and will escalate if error rate >0.5% above baseline.
mike-cs: Drafted customer note, will share in #customer-updates for review. Asking for approval to send in 30m after we confirm no regressions.
olga-sdks: I'll start a PR for v0.16.1 and a test harness to simulate older proxy behaviour. ETA for patch + tests: 6h initial, 24h full rollout.
dana-eng: We'll run a controlled canary re-roll only after SDK patch and proxy tolerance change. No reattempt until integration tests pass.
laura-ops: Adding incident timeline to the ticket. Initial alert 1779123456 -> flag disabled 1779123568 -> proxy revert 1779123625 -> metrics stable 1779123700. Closing thread here; will update with postmortem link.
raj-oncall: Thanks all. :white_check_mark: Follow-ups in the postmortem.
